component.name: SoundCloud
component.summary: SoundCloud Desktop Client with Studio Bass Boost, 10-band EQ, and Custom Wallpapers

description.p: Desktop SoundCloud client featuring a 10-band equalizer, natural Bass Boost with anti-clipping protection, animated video/GIF wallpapers, particle effects, cursor trails, Genius lyrics, Discord Rich Presence, and MPRIS2 media controls.
